data.one_liner: Customizable Cupertino picker with border and physics options
data.what_it_does: Provides a Cupertino picker that allows customizing the highlighter border color, width, and scroll physics. It replaces the default picker when you need visual tweaks or different scrolling behavior.
use_when: You need a Cupertino picker with a custom border or highlight color
You want to override the default scroll physics of the picker
You need a null‑safe picker for a Flutter 2+ project
avoid_when: You require full Cupertino picker features such as selection overlay or complex item builders
You are building a large form library that already includes a picker widget
strengths: Simple API for border and physics customization
Fully null‑safe and compatible with Flutter 2+
weaknesses: Limited to border and physics tweaks; no other customization options
